# isoplane setup

Check prerequisites and install matching project templates.

```bash
isoplane setup [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--source <source>` | Release directory or URL. |
| `-y, --yes` | Install missing native prerequisites without prompting. |
